title: Backup Storage
subtitle: Off-site storage (S3 / R2) where database backups are kept.
name: Name
editHint: Rotate credentials or rename. Bucket, endpoint, prefix and encryption are fixed once backups exist — change them with a new destination.
empty: Add S3-compatible storage below — until then, backups stay on the server's disk.
encryptHint: New destinations are encrypted by default. You will get a recovery key once; store it offline.
recoveryKey_body: Backups on "{name}" are encrypted with this key. It is shown only once. Without it (or the hub's own copy) they cannot be decrypted, so store it somewhere safe and offline.
delete_keyLoss: This destination is encrypted. Deleting it destroys the key its existing backups need.
delete_discardAck: Delete it anyway and discard the backups encrypted with its key
test_gpgMissing: gpg is not installed on the host, so encrypted backups cannot run.
legacyBanner_title: Some backup storage is not encrypted
legacyBanner_body: Backups written there are stored in cleartext. Existing destinations cannot be changed, so add a new encrypted destination and point your backups at it.
optOutWarning: Backups on this destination will be stored in cleartext. Anyone with access to the bucket can read your data.
